system.description:
An advanced variation of the "Hidden Shadow Shot" you prepare Two strikes with your weapon feigning that they are aimed at the same person. Your shots collide mid-air, sending them in different directions meant to strike different targets.

Select two targets, and make one ranged taijutsu attack targeting both comparing the result to both of their AC.

Both targets must make a Perception check versus result of the attack roll, on a failure they are both unable to gain the benefits of Temporary hit points or damage Reduction as a result of a Jutsu due to being caught off guard by the sudden split.

On hit, chosen enemies take you [Weapons damage] + [Weapons damage] + 2d8 damage.

Chain 2: Affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 5 ranks of Bleed on a failed save.

Chain 3: If this jutsu targets creatures with ranks of a Physical or Sensory condition, you make your attack with Advantage. If you score a critical hit with this jutsu, you can recast it targeting different creatures.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this above A-Rank, increase the cost by 3, the damage by 1d8.
